lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
United Airlines says it has a widespread system outage, just days after nationwide ground stop, The Associated Press reports.
United Airlines said Monday that it had resolved a technology issue that delayed departing flights, just days after a malfunction in the U.S, The Associated Press reports.
More than 180,200 people have signed a petition demanding former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang be reinstated, The Canadian Press reports.
UK leader Andy Burnham says Brexit hasn’t worked ahead of a reset summit with the EU, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
